newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Pacfic Retail says current yr starts well.
newsitem.headline: Pacfic Retail says current yr starts well.

text.p: New Zealand electrical appliance retailer Pacific Retail Group Limited said on Friday that an increase in profitability in the last quarter of the year to March 31 had been sustained into the first two months of the current year.

"A similar improved trading pattern has emerged in the two months after balance date," managing director Greg Lancaster said in a statement accompanying the company's results which showed a near 12 percent rise in net profit to NZ$2.3 million.
